info.title: Baybo Admin API
info.description: TCP + bearer-token surface: config, jobs, cron, traces, skills, tools, channels, LLM.

200.description: Aggregated tokens / cost / sessions over the time range

get.summary:
Cross-session view of in-flight background jobs (detached subagents +
`Bash` commands) — the dashboard twin of the per-session `JobList` tool.

schema.description:
Envelope for list endpoints. `next_cursor` is opaque — clients
pass it back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page, and treat
`None` as "no more pages." The cursor's internal scheme may change
across releases; clients must not parse it.

items.description: Read-only snapshot of a single registered channel.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum number of cron messages to return. Defaults to
[`DEFAULT_CRON_MESSAGE_LIMIT`], clamped to
[`MAX_CRON_MESSAGE_LIMIT`].

200.description: Cron-triggered http sessions with prompt + agent response previews, newest fire first

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Include hidden sessions in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: include_cron
parameters.description:
Include cron-triggered sessions in the response. Defaults to
false so the chat sidebar stays free of background fires; the
dedicated `GET /v1/chat/cron-messages` endpoint surfaces those
in their own pane.

parameters.name: before_ordinal
parameters.description:
Return only rows whose `ordinal` is strictly less than this
value. Omit on the initial fetch; pass the lowest ordinal from
the prior page to scroll further back. Maps to a primary-key
range scan over the `session_messages` active index.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Maximum rows to return. Defaults to
[`DEFAULT_HISTORY_LIMIT`], clamped to [`MAX_HISTORY_LIMIT`].

200.description: Per-session trace overview: session_messages log + job summaries (no step/span data). Untyped JSON to keep the admin surface decoupled from internal trace crate changes.

parameters.description: Session id this job belongs to (or inherits from); used for route scoping only

parameters.description: Job id whose step/span tree to fetch

200.description: Per-job step/span tree. `LlmCall` spans keep `input_messages` as `{ last_ordinal: i64, prefix_len: usize, suffix?: ChatMessage[] }` (Persisted — `prefix_len` is a tripwire the client checks against the reconstructed count, `suffix` carries framing/sub-loop messages not in the log, e.g. compression & progress-observer spans) or `ChatMessage[]` (Inline); the client slices the message log it received from the overview call and appends any `suffix`.

AnalyticsDayBucket.description:
One bucket per UTC day for the analytics chart.

`cost_micro_usd` is integer micro-USD (USD × 10^6). Rendering layers
divide by 1_000_000 to get USD; on-wire arithmetic stays exact.

cost_micro_usd.description: Spend for the day, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

AnalyticsModelBucket.description: Per-model breakdown row for the analytics dashboard.

cost_micro_usd.description: Spend for the model, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

AnalyticsReasonBucket.description:
Per-reason breakdown row for the analytics dashboard. `reason` is the
`CallReason` wire token (`chat`, `compression`, `tool`, …).

cost_micro_usd.description: Spend for the reason, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

since.description: Inclusive lower bound used for the aggregation (UTC).

total_cost_micro_usd.description: Total spend across the window, in **micro-USD** (1 USD = 1_000_000).

until.description: Exclusive upper bound used for the aggregation (UTC).

BackgroundJob.description:
One in-flight background job (detached subagent or `Bash` command),
across all sessions — the cross-session twin of the `JobList` tool.

kind.description: Subagent profile name, or `"command"` for a detached `Bash` command.

summary.description: Task summary (subagent) or the command line (command).

ChannelType.description:
Admin-surface mirror of [`baybo_model::ChannelType`]. Transparent
wrapper around a snake_case string so the OpenAPI surface stays
stable while the core type is open-ended (runtime-registered
sidecars like `"slack"` pass through unchanged).

ChatCronMessage.description:
One entry in the cron-messages list. Each row corresponds to a
distinct cron fire (cron creates a fresh session per trigger, so
`session_id` uniquely identifies the fire). The chat surface
surfaces these in a right-side notification pane rather than the
main sidebar so unattended cron output doesn't bury user-driven
conversations.

cron_job_id.description:
Cron job that produced this fire. Stable across fires of the
same job; missing in the (theoretically impossible) case of a
trigger without a job id.

fired_at.description:
When the cron session was created — the actual fire time, to
within scheduler tick precision.

last_active.description:
Latest activity timestamp on the session. Lets the panel sort
by "freshest" without the client having to fetch transcripts.

prompt.description:
The user-facing prompt for this fire. Truncated to
[`PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS`]. The persisted user row carries the cron
dispatcher's fire-time framing; `baybo_context::prompts::cron::original_cron_prompt`
recovers the instruction as configured so the panel shows that,
not the framing boilerplate.

response.description:
Latest assistant text — what the agent produced in response.
`None` while the fire is still running or if the agent emitted
only tool calls / attachments.

session_id.description:
The session created for this cron fire. Reuse against
`/v1/chat/sessions/{id}` to drill into the full transcript.

has_more.description:
`true` when at least one older active row exists below this page — i.e.
the client should keep scroll-up pagination armed. `false` when the slice
already includes the session's first message.

last_llm.description:
Per-session LLM pin (`session.state.last_llm`): the `baybo.json`
entry name this session's turns resolve against, or `null` to
follow `default-llm`. Drives the chat header model picker's
initial selection. Set via `PUT /v1/chat/sessions/{id}/model`.

oldest_ordinal.description:
Lowest / highest real `session_messages.ordinal` in this page (`null` for
an empty page). The client pages older with `before_ordinal = oldest`,
and seeds the WS replay cursor from `newest` — both must ignore the
synthetic ordinals on control-event transcript items.

transcript.description:
Active transcript slice, oldest-first within the page. Interleaves the
real message rows with out-of-band control events (slash echoes /
notices); a control-event item carries a synthetic negative `ordinal`, so
the client must NOT infer page bounds from transcript items — use
[`Self::oldest_ordinal`] / [`Self::newest_ordinal`] instead.

folder_id.description:
The user-created folder this session is filed under, or absent for
uncategorized. Set via `PUT /v1/chat/sessions/{id}/folder`; the web
sidebar groups rows by this id.

hidden.description:
True when the user has hidden this session from their chat
list. Only ever populated in responses when
`include_hidden=true` was requested.

last_user_text.description:
Preview text drawn from the session's most-recent user-authored
message, truncated to [`PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS`]. The web sidebar
renders this as the row label so users can scan past
conversations by what they last asked. `None` for sessions
without a user turn yet (a freshly-created row, or one whose
transcript holds only system/tool rows).

pinned.description:
True when the user has pinned this session to the top of their
chat list. Always emitted so the sidebar can place every row in
the right block; set via `PUT /v1/chat/sessions/{id}/pin`.

ChatTranscriptItem.description:
One transcript row, flattened from `ChatMessage` into a shape the
web client can render without re-implementing the content-block
matcher. Two shapes ride this struct, discriminated by [`Self::kind`]:
a `Message` (user / final-assistant bubble) or a `Work` (reconstructed
collapsed work block for a tool-using turn — see
[`reconstruct_transcript`]).

cancelled.description:
`true` when this `work` item belongs to a turn that was cancelled
(e.g. `/stop`) rather than run to a normal reply — the client labels it
"Cancelled" instead of a plain `Worked Xs`. Always false for
`message` / `notice` items.

created_at.description:
Wall-clock time the row was persisted, sourced from
`session_messages.created_at`. Lets the client render a
per-message timestamp without a second lookup. Live WS frames
don't carry this — the web client falls back to the receive
time for those, which is close enough for live emissions and
drifts only on catch-up replays (where the row is also
reachable via the REST history surface with the real value).

has_attachments.description:
`true` when this row had non-text content (image / audio /
file). The web client currently shows a placeholder.

kind.description: Message bubble vs. reconstructed work block.

notice_level.description:
Severity of a `notice` item (`"info"` / `"warn"` / `"error"`), so a reload
colors it the way the live frame did. `None` for `message` / `work` items.

ordinal.description:
React key for the row. For `message` / `work` items it is the
`session_messages.ordinal` (a `work` item carries the turn's first
intermediate ordinal so it sorts just after the user turn). For a
`notice` / control-echo item it is a **synthetic negative value** in a
key space disjoint from real ordinals — so the client must NOT use it for
pagination / cursor seeding; see `ChatSessionDetail::oldest_ordinal` /
`newest_ordinal`.

role.description:
`"user"` or `"assistant"` (or `"system"`). String rather than
enum to keep the wire forgiving. Empty for `work` items.

steps.description:
Reconstructed progress steps for a `work` item (reasoning, tool
calls + results, mid-turn narration). Empty for `message` items.

text.description:
Plain text content, newline-joined when multiple text blocks
were present. Empty when the message was media-only or for `work`
items.

work_started_at.description:
Open / close wall-clock of a `work` item, derived from the turn's
message timestamps — drives the `Worked Xs` label. `None` for
`message` items.

ChatWorkStep.description:
One reconstructed step inside a `work` transcript item — the durable
shadow of a live turn-progress event, rebuilt from persisted content
blocks so a reloaded transcript shows the same collapsed work summary
the live view did. `reasoning` / `prose` carry [`Self::text`]; `tool`
carries the call's name + a re-derived result summary.

text.description: Reasoning trace or mid-turn narration body. Empty for `tool` steps.

tool_label.description:
Short, best-effort label for the call (a path / command / url
pulled from the call input), absent the live `progress_label`.

tool_status.description:
`"ok"` / `"error"` / `"denied"`, derived from the persisted result
so reload can color-code failures the way the live view did.

tool_summary.description:
One-line summary re-derived from the persisted tool result. `None`
when the result for this call didn't land in the fetched window.

Deliberately a snippet of the actual result, not a content-light
count: this surface is the bearer-gated, operator-only chat reload
(never the live multi-channel fan-out), so it favors debugging
usefulness. Unlike the live `ToolCompleted.summary` it is NOT run
through `sanitize_stream_fragment`, so it can show raw tool output
the live UI withheld — acceptable for the operator's own view.

CreateCronRequest.description:
`POST /v1/cron` body. Schedule format is the standard 5-field cron
string accepted by [`baybo_cron`].

timezone.description:
IANA timezone (e.g. `"Asia/Shanghai"`) used to evaluate the cron
expression and to render time fields in responses. Required —
every time the API speaks is anchored to this zone, so callers
must commit to one explicitly.

ErrorBody.description:
Uniform error envelope for every non-2xx admin response.

`GatewayError::into_response` already emits `{"error": "..."}`; this
type just pins the shape in the spec so clients can discriminate on
it rather than on status codes alone.

FolderDto.description: One folder in a folder-list / create response.

Job.description:
Wire mirror of [`baybo_job::Job`]. Inner shape reflects the new
state machine (Q6) — `final_result` replaces `output`/`error`,
`emitted_span_ids` replaces `trace_span_id`.

input_kind.description: What payload fed the job (display-only projection of the input).

JobInputKind.description: Wire mirror of [`baybo_job::JobInputKind`] — what payload fed the job.

JobOrigin.description:
Wire mirror of a job's origin (the owning session's root trigger,
[`baybo_model::TriggerKind`]).

JobShape.description: Wire mirror of [`baybo_job::JobShape`] — turn vs maintenance.

JobStatus.description:
Wire mirror of [`baybo_job::JobStatus`]. Carries the same payload
the domain enum carries (cancel reason, partial-artifact span IDs);
the wire shape collapses inner-variant content into `Option`-typed
fields so HTTP clients can decode without needing the full Rust
enum machinery.

ListResponse_SlashCommandEntry.description:
Envelope for list endpoints. `next_cursor` is opaque — clients
pass it back as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page, and treat
`None` as "no more pages." The cursor's internal scheme may change
across releases; clients must not parse it.

items.description:
Wire DTO for slash command entries. Mirror of
[`baybo_channels::wire::SlashCommandSpec`] so the OpenAPI surface
stays inside this crate's DTOs (the wire type lives in
`baybo-channels` for sidecar reuse).

LlmModelEntry.description:
One row in `GET /v1/llm/models`. Carries both the raw config (so the
edit form can populate "override or unset" toggles) and the
**effective** values that result from layering overrides over the
factory / OpenRouter snapshot defaults.

api_key_configured.description:
`true` when an API key is currently resolvable for this entry
(vault entry, explicit `api_key_env`, or provider-default env
var). The literal value never leaves the gateway.

effective_context_window.description:
Effective `context_window` that the runtime would observe given
the current overrides and snapshot/factory defaults.

oneOf.description: Operator override for pricing fields. `None` = factory default.

LlmModelPricingDto.description:
Effective per-token pricing for a model after applying any operator
overrides — micro-USD per 1M tokens.

LlmModelTestResult.description:
`POST /v1/llm/models/{name}/test` response. Carries the latency and
token usage from a one-shot `ping` probe.

error.description:
On `ok: false`, a human-readable error suitable for direct
display (auth failure, network error, etc.).

latency_ms.description: Round-trip latency in ms (only on success).

provider.description:
Provider id used for the probe (may differ from the request's
`name` if the entry's provider was just edited).

LlmModelUsage.description:
One row in `GET /v1/llm/usage` — aggregated cost / token volume for
a single configured entry, joined by `entry.model == record.model`.

model.description: The `model` id used to look up records.

name.description: Entry `name`. May be unique per (provider, model) pair.

LlmPricingOverrideDto.description:
Per-entry pricing override fields. Wire shape mirrors
[`baybo_model::LlmPricingOverride`]; each field is integer micro-USD
per 1M tokens (1 USD = 1_000_000). The DTO exists separately from
the canonical struct only so we can derive `ToSchema` for utoipa
without leaking that derive into `baybo-model`.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound of the aggregation window.

LogEntry.description:
Mirror of [`crate::log_buffer::LogRecord`]. Used as the item type of
[`LogsResponse`].

target.description:
Tracing target that emitted the record (e.g.
`baybo_gateway::server`). Rendered as "source" in the UI.

LogField.description:
Single structured tracing field (`k=v`) captured alongside a log
record. Kept as free-form strings — formatting / unquoting happens
in the emitter.

LogLevel.description:
Mirror of [`crate::log_buffer::LogLevel`]. Snake-cased on the wire to
match the rest of the admin surface.

LogsResponse.description:
Envelope for `GET /v1/logs`. Unlike [`ListResponse`] we expose
`total` so the UI can render pagination (`Showing X of N`).

total.description:
Total number of records matching the filters — independent of
`limit`/`offset`, so clients can size the pager without asking
for the full list.

parent_id.description: New parent id, or `null` to promote the folder to top-level.

gateway_push_pubkey.description:
Lowercase hex of the gateway's 32-byte Ed25519 push verifying key. The
client signs a delegation over this key (authorizing it to manage the
binding at C) before `POST /v1/push/register`.

apns_token.description: The client's current APNs device token (hex).

delegation.description:
Lowercase hex of the 64-byte Ed25519 delegation: the client's device key
authorizing the gateway push key returned by `GET /v1/push/params`.

device_id.description:
The client's self-certifying `device_id` (`ios-<hex(ed25519 pub)>`); the
gateway recovers the public key from it and re-derives the canonical id.

push_key.description:
Lowercase hex of the 32-byte preview AEAD key the client also stored in
its App-Group keychain (so its NSE can decrypt). Generated client-side and
delivered over this TLS + admin-token channel.

device_id.description: The `ios-<hex(pub)>` id the binding was stored under (== the push `bid`).

ReloadOutcome.description:
Outcome of a successful reload, surfaced to the operator (HTTP
response + logs).

active_model.description: Model id of the (possibly new) default entry now serving turns.

dropped.description:
Non-default entries that failed to build and were dropped with a
warning (mirrors boot's failure policy).

entries.description: All entry names present in the rebuilt pool.

ordered_ids.description: The sibling ids in their new order.

parent_id.description: Parent of the sibling group being reordered (`null` = top-level).

SessionKind.description:
Wire mirror of [`baybo_query::SessionKind`]. Coarse trigger/lineage
label for the trace browser list view.

value.description: JSON value written at `path`. Shape validated by `BayboConfig`.

folder_id.description: Target folder id, or `null` to clear the assignment (uncategorized).

llm.description:
`baybo.json` LLM entry name to pin this session to, or `null`
(absent) to clear the pin and follow `default-llm`. Must match a
configured entry — see `GET /v1/llm/models` → `items[].name`.

applied_to_live_actor.description:
`true` when a live actor was re-pinned in place (applies on the
session's next turn); `false` when only the persisted state was
updated because no actor is currently running (the next user
message spawns one that reads the pin).

last_llm.description: The pin now in effect: the entry name, or `null` for `default-llm`.

pinned.description:
`true` to pin this session to the top of the chat list, `false`
to unpin it back into the regular list.

SlashCommandEntry.description:
Wire DTO for slash command entries. Mirror of
[`baybo_channels::wire::SlashCommandSpec`] so the OpenAPI surface
stays inside this crate's DTOs (the wire type lives in
`baybo-channels` for sidecar reuse).

TraceSessionSummary.description:
One row of the trace browser list view. Mirrors
[`baybo_query::SessionSummary`] for the wire.

oneOf.description:
`None` when the session has no jobs (those rows are filtered
out, but the type stays Option to keep the wire shape stable
if the policy ever flips).

TracesListResponse.description:
Envelope for `GET /v1/traces`. Carries `total` for "Showing X of N"
pagers, matching the shape of [`LogsResponse`].

UpdateLlmModelRequest.description:
`PUT /v1/llm/models/{name}` body. Every field is optional — only
present fields are applied. To clear an override pass an explicit
`null` (handled by including the key in the request JSON; serde
can't distinguish "missing key" from "key with null" by default, so
the handler treats `Some(None)` as clear and an absent key as keep).

api_key.description:
Set the literal API key in the vault (`llm.entry.<name>.api_key`).
Pass `""` to remove the vault entry, or omit the field to leave
the vault untouched. Never echoed back.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name holding the API key, or `null` to clear.

base_url.description: Custom base URL or `null` to clear.

model.description: Set the model id (e.g. `"gpt-4o"`). Requires gateway restart.

provider.description: Set the provider id (e.g. `"openai"`). Requires gateway restart.

WorkStepKind.description:
Kind of a reconstructed [`ChatWorkStep`] — serialized as
`"reasoning"` / `"prose"` / `"tool"`.
